attributes.board_name: Vermont Office of Professional Regulation - Social Workers

rules.accepted_credit_types: Accredited colleges/universities; national, regional or state social work organizations or state boards; professional organizations in medicine, law, administration, education and behavioral sciences; approved in-service programs; programs approved by NASW, NASW Vermont, CSWE or ASWB (Rule 6.8).
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE required from the first renewal after two years of licensure; recommended but not required before that (Rule 6.2).

topics.who: Ethics of social work practice incl. boundaries, confidentiality, dual relationships
Licensed mental health professionals: systematic oppression and anti-oppressive practice (Act 117 of 2022), from the January 2026 renewal; online accepted

rules.legal_basis: Vermont OPR Administrative Rules for Social Workers (eff. July 1, 2017), Part 6; Act 117 (2022)
rules.notes: Biennial renewal (January of even years per OPR). At least 15 hours formal in-person education (live synchronous virtual accepted per H.305 of 2023); max 5 hours informal/self-directed.
rules.rule_quote: (1) L.I.C.S.W.: Each licensed independent clinical social worker is required to document and complete twenty (20) hours of continuing education taken during the concluding licensing period.

rules.legal_basis: Vermont OPR Administrative Rules for Social Workers (eff. July 1, 2017), Part 6; Act 117 (2022)
rules.notes: Biennial renewal (January of even years per OPR). All 10 hours must be formal education (conferences, workshops, academic courses, live webinars, in-service programs).
rules.rule_quote: (2) L.M.S.W.: Each licensed master’s social worker is required to document and complete ten (10) hours of continuing education taken in a formal setting during the concluding licensing period.
